def toks(f):
    cells=set()
    for i in range(20,45):
        row=f.ascii.split('\n')[i]
        for j in range(64):
            if row[j]=='N': cells.add((i,j))
    toks=[]
    for (i,j) in sorted(cells):
        for t in toks:
            if any(abs(i-ti)<=3 and abs(j-tj)<=3 for ti,tj in t):
                t.append((i,j)); break
        else: toks.append([(i,j)])
    out=[]
    for t in toks:
        rs=[x[0] for x in t]; cs=[x[1] for x in t]
        out.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
def wall(f):
    row=f.ascii.split('\n')[30]
    return [j for j in range(33,41) if row[j]=='p']
